title: prove controlled multi-node canary execution preconditions and rollback readiness

criteria: Hosted mirror, endpoint verifier, fail-closed fixtures, frontend, and user release channel evidence are hash-bound.
RC4 staged rollout smoke, rollout projection, rollback projection, and fleet authority evidence are consumed without widening authority.

Canary execution remains blocked until at least two canary nodes are enrolled, exact operator approval is granted, and remote fleet execution is enabled through AgentCore plus SecurityExecutionEngine.
Rollback readiness is proven from the RC4 rollback baseline while rollback execution remains unperformed.
